legalBoundary: Engineering evidence is not legal advice, jurisdiction acceptance, certification, or production authorization.

controls.control: Receive, assess, address and conclude lifecycle with trust, impartiality and protection boundaries.
controls.doesNotProve: Organizational independence, legal adequacy, or ISO certification.

controls.control: Confidential channel with authorized follow-up, configurable seven-day acknowledgment and three-month feedback controls.
acceptance: Overdue evidence without narrative or identity disclosure
controls.doesNotProve: Applicability to a specific entity, country implementation, or legal sign-off.

controls.control: Versioned speak-up governance, segregation of duties, escalation ownership and continual improvement evidence.
controls.doesNotProve: ISO certification or operating effectiveness without independent assessment.

controls.control: No-collect and no-correlation defaults for reporter identity, transport metadata, secrets, logs, traces and analytics.
acceptance: Public edge and application leak sentinels absent
controls.doesNotProve: DPIA acceptance, KVKK/GDPR legal basis, VERBIS status, or production legal go.

controls.control: Least privilege, product-cell isolation, cryptographic secret handling, incident response, backup and restore controls.
acceptance: Org and product scoped deny matrix
controls.doesNotProve: ISO certification, control operating effectiveness, or customer assurance acceptance.

controls.control: Customer-configured audit-committee routing for confidential and anonymous accounting complaints with anti-retaliation governance.
controls.doesNotProve: Issuer status, U.S. legal applicability, or audit-committee approval.

source.name: U.S. DOJ Evaluation of Corporate Compliance Programs

controls.control: Confidential reporting, channel awareness, investigation quality, retaliation monitoring and effectiveness review.
controls.doesNotProve: DOJ acceptance, legal compliance, or program operating effectiveness.

source.name: OWASP ASVS 4.x and API Security Top 10

controls.control: Fail-closed authentication and authorization, input limits, enumeration resistance, rate limiting and secret-safe error handling.
acceptance: No raw secret in error or telemetry
controls.doesNotProve: Penetration-test coverage or absence of all vulnerabilities.

controls.control: Public intake, receipt, mailbox and staff critical paths remain keyboard, assistive-technology and contrast accessible.
controls.doesNotProve: Full legal accessibility conformance without manual and user testing.

controls.control: High-entropy accountless mailbox secret with verifier-side protection, throttling, replay resistance and revocation.
acceptance: Secret is not server-returned or logged
controls.doesNotProve: NIST identity-assurance conformance for an accountless reporter.

controls.control: Allowlisted operational telemetry without reporter identity, case narrative, receipt, access secret, client IP, referrer or user-agent correlation.
acceptance: Synthetic sentinel absent from logs, traces and metric labels
controls.doesNotProve: Absence in unmanaged external infrastructure or production systems not included in the scan.

controls.control: Traceable logical-access, change-management, confidentiality, monitoring and availability evidence.
controls.doesNotProve: SOC 2 examination, auditor opinion, or customer assurance acceptance.

controls.control: Optional AI assistance is redacted, purpose-limited, human-reviewed and unable to decide culpability, discipline or case closure.
acceptance: CORE acceptance remains independent of AI
Provider data-flow and redaction policy approved
Human override and audit are enforced
controls.doesNotProve: AI legal compliance, model safety, fairness, or authorization for production use.
